## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO strategy aims to capture the edge in 0DTE options trading by vetoing call entries when a bearish structure is confirmed. This approach seeks to improve the overall performance of the trading system by reducing the number of losing trades.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using a trendline break structure signal to veto call entries. The signal is generated when a bearish trendline is broken, indicating a potential reversal in the market direction. The veto is applied to call entries to prevent the system from taking long positions when the market is likely to move against them.
